title: Building Benchmarks from the Ground Up: Community-Centered Evaluation of LLMs in Healthcare Chatbot Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to culturally grounded healthcare queries sourced from Indian communities. The evaluation uses native-speaker human annotators and LLM-as-a-judge techniques based on rubrics co-designed with local Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) to reflect local social norms, cultural practices, and nuanced healthcare realities.
Assessing and comparing model performance across three non-Western Indic languages (Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada) to determine how well LLMs handle localized, non-English multi-lingual queries.
Using one of the evaluated models (Sarvam-M) as an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate and compare its own generated outputs against those of competing models to detect algorithmic self-preference.
